p1: Isaiah wrote a song for the people to sing someday. It was a song about trusting the Lord.
The song says the Lord will keep you “in perfect peace.” That is a calm, quiet feeling, deep in your heart.
That peace comes when your mind is “stayed” on the Lord. Your thoughts stay close to Him, because you trust Him.
p2: Isaiah said, “Trust ye in the Lord for ever.” He called Him the Lord Jehovah, Jesus’s name long ago. In Him is “everlasting strength,” strength that never, ever runs out.
When your mind feels busy or jumbled, think about Jesus. Say softly, “I trust You.” Feel your heart grow calm.
old: Isaiah shared a lovely secret about how to feel calm and peaceful inside, even when the world is busy.
“Heavenly Father will keep you in perfect peace,” Isaiah said, “when you keep your mind on Him.”
That means when we fill our thoughts with Heavenly Father — thinking about His love, remembering His stories — our hearts grow calm and quiet and peaceful.
It’s like when your mind is buzzing with worries, and then you think one gentle thought about Heavenly Father, and the buzzing settles into soft, warm peace.
Heavenly Father wants to give you peace. When your thoughts turn to Him, He fills you up with a calm, safe, wonderful peace — the perfect kind.
